citation: PyPSA 24/7 CFE research project. Reproducible model workflows and study releases. https://github.com/PyPSA/247-cfe
description: The 24/7 CFE repository publishes PyPSA-based models and reproducible workflows for studying hourly carbon-free electricity procurement. It contains code for three research studies, with configuration, sample networks, scripts and Snakemake steps that build solved networks, CSV summaries and plots. Inputs include preprocessed European electricity systems and procurement scenarios; outputs are power-system and cost comparisons. The studies use different formulations and spatial scopes, so there is no one fixed grid or horizon for the whole repository. Code is free under MIT terms, while inputs and manuscript material have separate open licences. A limitation is that two other studies are maintained in dedicated repositories and complete reproduction can require substantial input data and solver resources. The repository supports electricity market and capacity-planning questions. PyPSA (model-pypsa) is the underlying related model. The workflow was read but not executed, and no model network was downloaded.
inputs: European electricity networks and procurement scenarios
